svg.title: RT-DETR-R18 with dual-scale AIFI, SlimNeck and training-only Inner-GIoU
svg.desc: Independent P4 and P5 AIFI branches with GSConv projections (P3 bypasses AIFI), SlimNeck with four VoVGSCSP fusions each repeated three times and a GSConv stride-2 downsample in each bottom-up stage, producing the F3, F4 and F5 neck outputs at layers 21, 24 and 27. All three levels are projected per level and passed to the unchanged RT-DETR decoder with 300 queries, selected by Top-K encoder score. The dashed rose branch below the decoder is the training-only Hungarian matching and Inner-GIoU localization objective; it adds no inference-time parameters. Thumbnail backgrounds are editable vector traces of GC10-DET img_01_425241500_00995.jpg. The output box and rounded confidence reproduce the existing combined-model val_batch0_pred.jpg visualization, not a new inference run.
